### Install and connect

- **Windows:** download and run the EXE installer.
- **Mac:** open the DMG and drag Lettide into Applications.

Node.js is included. Chinese downloads use 叠信; English downloads use Lettide. Change the interface language in Settings.

Google and Microsoft require an OAuth app for the first connection; QQ Mail requires an app password. [Account setup](https://github.com/shixi-11/lettide/blob/main/docs/account-setup.en.md). Download the offline translation model once (about 920 MB); email bodies then stay on your device during translation.

These installers are unsigned previews. The Mac app is not notarized.

### 安装与连接

- **Windows：**下载并双击 EXE 安装程序。
- **Mac：**打开 DMG，把叠信拖入「应用程序」。

内置 Node.js，无需另装运行环境。中文下载显示「叠信」，英文下载显示「Lettide」，界面语言可在设置中切换。

Google 和 Microsoft 首次连接需要 OAuth 应用，QQ 邮箱需要授权码。[邮箱接入](https://github.com/shixi-11/lettide/blob/main/docs/邮箱接入.md)。离线翻译模型首次下载约 920 MB，之后翻译只在本机处理邮件正文。

当前为未签名预览版，Mac 未经过 Apple 公证。
